item.title: Version 1.5.39
item.description:
🎉 v1.5.39 Update

  • ✨ ChatGPT OAuth Sign-In for Inline AI
    - You can now connect ChatGPT directly from Inline AI settings with OAuth login.
  • 🔧 Inline AI Interaction Improvements
    - Added a new chat control flow and improved copy state behavior.
    - Refined button hover and press feedback for a smoother panel experience.
    - Improved text selection stability and panel visibility across external apps.
  • 🐛 Important Stability Fixes
    - Fixed streaming session mixups between Inline AI conversations.
    - Prevented unexpected panel close during focus transfer.
    - Fixed duplicate case-convert paste in save fields.
    - Fixed overlapping referenced text in chat bubbles.
